product.title: Summer Plaid Family Matching Set - Hoodie, Tee & Shorts
product.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Lightweight summer woven and knit pieces; exact fiber content was not visible in the supplied evidence.
  • Family story: A coordinated warm-weather outfit for mom, dad, girls, and boys, built from matching beige plaid and easy neutral layers.
  • Print: Summer Plaid pairs soft beige checks with a cream graphic tee and muted gray-green cargo shorts.
  • Design details: Choose the hooded plaid overshirt, short-sleeve graphic T-shirt, or cargo shorts by size to build each family member's look.
  • Care: Machine wash cold on gentle, line dry, do not bleach, and cool iron inside-out if needed.
  • Size range: Child 1-2Y-10Y and Adult S-3XL across hooded shirts, T-shirts, and shorts.

Summer Plaid is an easy family outfit for travel days, park dates, school-break photos, and casual weekend plans. The beige plaid hooded shirt gives the look its matching anchor, while the cream tee and cargo shorts keep the set relaxed and wearable.

The pieces are listed separately inside one family matching product so you can build the outfit honestly by person and garment. Pick the hooded shirt, T-shirt, or shorts in the child or adult size each family member needs.

Key Features:

  • Three-piece coordination: Hooded shirt, graphic tee, and cargo shorts are all supported by the attached vendor chart.
  • Family-size ladder: Child 80-150 and adult S-3XL rows are included for every listed garment.
  • Neutral summer palette: Beige plaid, cream, and gray-green tones are easy to photograph together.
  • Buildable matching look: Mix the top and bottom pieces per family member instead of buying an unsupported bundle.
  • Draft-only safety: Created as an unpublished Shopify draft pending operator review.

Choose each garment and size to build a coordinated summer look for the whole family.
